items.title: Red Flag watch: evacuation playbooks are ready
items.body: Red Flag Warning until 18:00. I re-ran the playbooks for 3 zones against tonight's forecast (ENE 14 G24, RH 12%). Upper Encinal has one road out to the south; the north exit is Mulholland Hwy.

items.title: Pre-position E-31 at the Encinal junction?
items.body: For the Red Flag window. It cuts E-31's response to Zone 1 from 9 to 7 min. E-31 is idle on PCH east.
why: Response to Zone 1: 9 min from PCH east, 7 min from the junction
Red Flag Warning in effect until 18:00
No other engine covers the canyon mouth

items.title: Heat detection on Trancas ridge
items.body: S-7 thermal mast · 74% match to a flame signature · 34°03.49′N 118°50.92′W. FT-01 is on its way to look, on scene in 1:14.
why: 74% match is below my confirm threshold (85%)
FT-01 can see it in 1:14; confirming blind costs nothing to wait for

items.standing: SO-2 · verify detections in pre-cleared airspace
items.title: FT-01 retasked to the detection
items.body: Airspace box TRANCAS-2 is pre-cleared. Sweep paused.

items.title: The detection you dismissed is real
items.body: FT-01 IR shows active flame at 388 °C. Your dismissal stays on the record; I have opened the incident on the new evidence and copied the Regional Duty Supervisor.

items.title: Confirmed: vegetation fire
items.body: FT-01 IR: 1.1 ac, 1272 m from the nearest home, running WSW into the backcountry with the wind.

items.standing: Run card ENC-N · normal dispatch level
items.title: E-32 dispatched

items.standing: SO-2 · verify detections in pre-cleared airspace
items.title: FT-02 launched from dock D-2
items.body: Mapping the perimeter on a 260 m orbit.

items.title: Projection: WSW into the backcountry at 11 m/min
items.body: 1.7 ac now. 0 homes inside the +60 min projection; 11 within 750 m of the flank get an advisory. The canyon mouth is off the right flank.
items.basis: Spread model v3 · FT-01 IR perimeter 1 min old · RAWS 4 min old

items.title: Report the fire to the county authority?
items.body: Type 4, 1.9 ac, no homes in the projection — no evacuation is proposed. The county still requires the report within 30 min of confirmation, and it is the CAD entry that queues the mutual-aid dozer if the wind turns.
items.basis: County fire code §F-210 (exercise) · CAD report format

gate.label: REPORT TO COUNTY FIRE AUTHORITY · VEGETATION FIRE
gate.reach: CAD report · size, location, resources, no evacuation
gate.check: Report drafted from live telemetry · geofence matches the advisory only
gate.onExpire: Nothing is sent. The report is still required; I escalate to the Regional Duty Supervisor.

why: Confirmed vegetation fire: the county requires a report within 30 min, evacuation or not
The CAD entry is what makes a county dozer available if this grows
Confirmation was at T+0:02 — the statutory clock is running
No public alert is drafted: nothing here touches the public

items.title: Report sent · County Fire Authority
items.body: CAD entry from live telemetry: Type 4, 2.2 ac, WSW into the backcountry, E-32 on scene, no evacuation. Advisory going to 11 homes near the flank.

items.title: The report lapsed without a decision
items.body: Nothing was sent. Silence is not approval: the report is still required, so I escalated to the Regional Duty Supervisor.

items.title: Plan P-2: direct attack — anchor and cut
items.body: E-31 anchors the flank where the line starts, the county dozer (queued by your report) cuts 634 m of flank line, FT-02 maps the perimeter every 6 min. No evacuation: the advisory covers the nearest homes.
items.basis: TALON attack model · flank ROS ≈ 60% of head · dozer line at 0.45 m/s
why: The head runs at 11 m/min into open backcountry — a flank line can catch it
The dozer is already queued by the report: no new request, no new delay
11 homes sit within 750 m of the flank; the advisory is not a substitute for a line
Monitoring waits for the wind to decide

items.title: Executing P-2
items.body: E-31 to the anchor point, DZ-4 starts the flank line on arrival, FT-02 continues mapping.

items.title: Wind turned 15° — the flank is running
items.body: The flank is now the head, toward the 11 advisory homes. Monitoring is no longer the cheap option. The choice and this consequence are both on the record.

items.title: County dozer on scene · cutting the flank
The line held
items.body: Perimeter stopped at 53.9 ac — the projection had 53.9 ac by now. The head is backing into the burn; FT-02 confirms no crossing.

items.title: Contained (IC report)
items.body: Line complete at 53.9 ac. E-32 mopping up; the dozer finishes the flank at T+1:04.

items.title: Release FT-01 back to its sweep?
items.body: E-32 has eyes on the fire and the line is holding. FT-01 battery 31%.
why: The line is holding and FT-02 continues mapping
Two canyon sectors have gone unswept for 40 minutes

items.title: The incident log is ready for review
items.body: Every recommendation, decision, dissent and standing-order action is on the record.
